New Container Apps registry-selection fact, not a renamed c017 App Service ARM-token prerequisite. No ABAC mode or role-scope generalization is added.

New queue-versus-subscription address selection, not scale-to-zero activation or scaler credential wiring.
New three-part composition: active time window, highest-rule request, then replica limits. Counts are supplied observations rather than unsupported HTTP formula assumptions.
New Event Hubs topology limit. No claim that the scaler automatically changes partitions, and no promise that adding partitions would repair every throughput problem.
Preserves c037 two-control fact. Removes unsupported TCP-specific assertions and distinguishes each partial repair with an actual correct-when condition. No probe defaults or Preview extensions used.
Same c032 declarative-release fact, replacing unsupported manual container edits with a documented restart countercontext. Concrete desired fields and post-apply verification, not an Advanced label.
Same c033 mapping. Countercontexts do not recommend storing a live credential in a ConfigMap.
Same c034 Service contract, distinct from conventional App Service c018; no implicit TLS behavior is inferred from the numeric port.
Same c035 prior-instance evidence fact. No live cluster commands were executed and sufficient log access remains required.
Same c036 selector/endpoint fact; Intermediate rather than the previously overstated Advanced classification.
New scheduling diagnosis combines per-node fit, aggregate capacity, request/limit distinction and measured lower bound. No false claim that CPU limits cause OOM termination.
New three-consumer refresh decision. Distinct from c033 choosing the resource kind; no claim of instantaneous volume update or automatic application reload.
New foundational key-metadata inspection, separate from generic secret retrieval and environment injection. Names are fictional and no secret values are accessed.
New acceptance-path scope. Does not claim kubectl port-forward exercises every Service network data-plane component.
New two-axis log selection. Distinct from c035 previous-versus-current instance selection; this item asks for the current instance and resolves namespace/container ambiguity.

exclusions: No raw assessment, knowledge-check, exercise or quiz content was fetched or used.
No withdrawn documentation article was reinstated. Only freshly retrieved direct substantive units with complete current course/path/module ancestry support candidate claims.

Sidecar module and four units, AKS persistent storage, Container Apps lifecycle/resource optimization and scale compute units were fetched by bounded curriculum discovery but are not in the existing explicit allowlist or not needed. They are not reviewed source approvals and do not support candidates.

Training overstatements about tag write-lock deletion/retention, purge aging, request/limit behavior, universal LoadBalancer public exposure, automatic registry authorization, HTTP averaging and example throughput arithmetic were not adopted.
limitations: Exactly 40 candidates are authored, not 40 verified or playable questions. Independent technical and adversarial contexts must inspect unchanged hashes and the full evidence.

Difficulty is honestly 7 Beginner, 28 Intermediate, 5 Advanced, zero Expert rather than forcing the requested 15/35/35/15 mix. The limited scope supports applied implementation and diagnosis but does not justify Expert labels on these records.
All seven first-domain subskills are represented. 33 candidates are author-classified applied rather than recall; this classification is not an independent realism judgment.
Cross-bank heuristics cannot prove semantic originality. Existing known duplicate exclusions and full-peer reads are authoring constraints, not new semantic review decisions.
